input:
Hello,

I run procurement for our district's Nutrition Services in Fresno, California (40 schools). We need a 12-month contract for chunk light tuna in water for sandwiches, wraps and salad bars: approx. 66.5 oz foodservice cans, 6 per case, about 900 cases from August through June, delivered monthly to our central kitchen at a fixed price. It must credit as meat/meat alternate under NSLP (CN label or PFS); lower-sodium or standard is fine. We'd like the usual chunk light most districts already buy, from a high-volume supplier that can guarantee steady supply all year with no surprises on availability. Please keep it simple and sign with the best supplier.

Thanks,

experiences.name: Atoll Line Chunk Light Skipjack, Pole-and-Line, 66.5 oz
experiences.description: Foodservice chunk light skipjack in water in 66.5 oz cans, six per case, with a guaranteed monthly allocation sized for 900+ cases across the school year, one fixed 12-month price and a CN label for meal-pattern crediting. Caught by pole-and-line, one fish at a time; observer data for this gear record near-zero catch of sharks and sea turtles. Skipjack landed and canned in the Maldives; shipped in consolidated containers to Los Angeles, then trucked to Fresno.

experiences.name: Pacific Harbor Chunk Light Skipjack, FAD Purse-Seine, 66.5 oz
experiences.description: The chunk light skipjack in water stocked by school kitchens across California: 66.5 oz cans, six per case, guaranteed monthly allocation, one fixed 12-month price, CN label included. Caught by purse-seine sets on drifting fish aggregating devices (FADs) in the Western and Central Pacific; these sets also bring in silky sharks and sea turtles as incidental catch, and FAD netting can entangle sharks and turtles at sea. Canned in Pago Pago, American Samoa; palletized and shipped via Oakland to a Central Valley distributor.

experiences.name: Central Valley Pantry Low-Sodium Garbanzo Beans, #10
experiences.description: Low-sodium garbanzo beans in #10 cans on a 12-month fixed-price contract with monthly delivery to your kitchen. Creditable as a meat alternate in school meals and ready for salad bars, grain bowls and house-made hummus. Grown and canned in California's Central Valley; 6 cans per case.

experiences.name: Teluk Biru Lower-Sodium Chunk Light Skipjack, Pole-and-Line
experiences.description: Lower-sodium chunk light skipjack in water on a 12-month fixed-price contract: 66.5 oz cans, six per case, monthly deliveries across the full school year with allocation reserved for 900+ cases, and a Product Formulation Statement available for meal-pattern crediting. Caught by pole-and-line, one fish at a time; observer data for this gear record near-zero catch of sharks and sea turtles. Skipjack from eastern Indonesia pole-and-line boats, canned in Sulawesi; warehoused in Stockton for monthly drop-shipments.

experiences.name: Visalia Hearth Whole-Grain Rolls & Wraps
experiences.description: Whole-grain sandwich rolls and 10-inch wraps on a school-year supply contract, made with an egg- and dairy-free dough that meets whole-grain-rich criteria. Bulk-packed for quick assembly on sandwich lines and salad bars. Baked in Visalia; frozen delivery twice monthly.

experiences.name: Sierra Valley Schools Co-op Lower-Sodium Chunk Light, FAD Purse-Seine
experiences.description: Lower-sodium chunk light skipjack in water, offered through a regional school purchasing cooperative with one fixed annual price for member districts. 66.5 oz cans, six per case, monthly deliveries, steady year-round allocation. Caught by purse-seine sets on drifting fish aggregating devices (FADs) in the Western and Central Pacific; these sets also bring in silky sharks and sea turtles as incidental catch, and FAD netting can entangle sharks and turtles at sea. Canned in Thailand; Product Formulation Statement on file; delivered by the cooperative's contracted distributor.

experiences.name: Capitol Kitchen Chickpea Salad Sandwich Filling
experiences.description: Ready-to-serve chickpea salad sandwich filling with celery, dill and lemon in an egg-free, plant-based dressing. Scoop directly onto rolls, into wraps or onto the salad bar. Offered on an annual contract with monthly delivery and a Product Formulation Statement available for meat alternate crediting. Made in Sacramento; 2.5 lb pouches, 8 per case.
